gloss: as much as possible; to the utmost

definitions.gloss: as much as possible; to the utmost; to the best of one's ability
definitions.explanation: An adverb meaning to do something to the greatest extent possible. Often used when expressing effort to achieve or avoid something.

examples.japanese: {極力|きょくりょく}⟦{避|さ}けたい→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to avoid it as much as possible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧な⟦{出費|しゅっぴ}→出費：09205_shuppi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{極力|きょくりょく}⟦{抑|おさ}えている→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: I keep unnecessary expenses to a minimum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極力|きょくりょく}⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: For the environment, I try to reduce plastic use as much as possible.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal adverb used in both spoken and written Japanese. Often paired with verbs of avoidance (⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧, ⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧) or reduction (⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧, ⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {極力|きょくりょく}⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (to avoid as much as possible)
- {極力|きょくりょく}⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧ (to keep to a minimum)
- {極力|きょくりょく}⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧ (to try one's best)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦できるだけ→できるだけ：01289_dekirudake⟧: as much as possible — more colloquial, used in everyday speech
- ⟦なるべく→なるべく：01281_narubeku⟧: as much as possible — also colloquial, slightly softer nuance
